T0: frozen initial members/config, no final registry
T1: first accepted create_task or claim_task; ownership can still be unclaimed
T2: first accepted actual content-changing edit where recoverable; unknown content changes separately marked
T3: first fixed artifact publication or peer read, not proof of receipt
T4: first executed public-test failure; missing if none observed
T5: first integration, accepted owner transfer or edit after observed failed test
T6: before first submit attempt, no response or terminal score in that snapshot
